{{Top|leg}}
'''Scream of the Ssurian''' was a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Dathomir Magic|technique]] that could bring forth the deep thrumming vibrations of the [[Ssurian/Legends|ssurian]] dragon's hunting call, as well as the earth-splitting shriek of its territorial warning. When directed at an enemy, the wave of sound would shatter teeth and pop eardrums.
